note: sketch.scale drew a toolbar button that reached no tool and no dialog, so a press ran the command with no parameters at all and the engine answered "`factor` must be a positive number". It now opens a tool window carrying Entities, a Base point and a Factor.
The dead-button regression: the press opens a window, commits nothing and reports nothing. A pick fills the input and still commits nothing.
Escape leaves the sketch exactly as it was.

The typed factor reaches the command unchanged: all four sides picked and 2 typed doubles the rectangle about the sketch origin, so its area goes from 200 to 800 mm2 and its far corner from (20, 10) to (40, 20).
Starting the command again and pressing Escape leaves the document and the undo history untouched.
